theses.thesis: T1: Biotechnology consumables growth will keep offsetting Life Sciences weakness through 2026.
theses.signpost: Biotechnology core sales growth at or above 5% and Life Sciences core sales turning positive in each 2026 quarterly report; first full read at Q4 2026 report in February 2027 [4].

theses.thesis: T2: The current valuation requires growth well above history, so at consensus growth the shares are unlikely to earn their cost of capital.
theses.signpost: FY2026 reported revenue of at least $26.26B (about 6.9% growth), per the February 2027 annual filing [3]; invalidation if FY2026 growth is below 3% or guidance is cut [4].

theses.thesis: T3: Earnings momentum will continue as estimates keep rising.
theses.signpost: Q4 2026 EPS at or above consensus and FY2026 EPS of at least $8.59, reported in February 2027 [3]; invalidation if Q4 misses or FY2026 guidance falls below $8.50 [4].

theses.thesis: T4: Shareholder returns will outrun free cash flow, so balance-sheet capacity narrows.
theses.signpost: FY2026 buybacks below $3.0B in the February 2027 annual filing, or net debt rising again in that filing [2]; invalidation if free cash flow stays at or above $5.3B while net debt falls [4].
